table.retrieve:
SELECT  IC.Icatcode, 
	Ic.Name,
	grossvalue = ROUND(SUM(
		CASE P.TYPE WHEN 'S' THEN
			P.grossvalue 
		ELSE 0 END), 0),
	discvalue = ROUND ( SUM ( 
		CASE P.TYPE WHEN 'S' THEN
			P.itemdiscvalue + P.invitemdiscvalue +
									P.flatdisc * ( P.itemvalue/
									CASE P.grossamt WHEN 0 THEN 1 
									ELSE P.grossamt END)
		ELSE 0 END), 0),
	salevalue=ROUND(SUM(
		CASE P.TYPE WHEN 'S' THEN
			P.itemvalue - (P.flatdisc *(P.itemvalue/
			CASE P.grossamt WHEN 0 THEN 1 
			ELSE P.grossamt END))
		ELSE 0 END), 0),
	returnval=ROUND(SUM(
		CASE P.TYPE WHEN 'R' THEN
			P.itemvalue - (P.flatdisc*(P.itemvalue/
				CASE P.grossamt WHEN 0 THEN 1 
				ELSE P.grossamt END)) 
		ELSE 0 END), 0),
	gstvalue = sum(p.gstvalue)
FROM 
(
SELECT
	saleledger.saleinvcode,
	saledetail.icode,
	GrossValue = SUM(saledetail.looseqty * saledetail.saleprice ) ,
	ItemDiscValue = SUM((saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc))*
						 (.01 * saledetail.discperc) + saledetail.itemflatdisc ),
	InvItemDiscValue = SUM((saledetail.looseqty*(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc))*
							(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc) ) *  (.01 * saleledger.discperc) ),
	ItemValue=SUM((saledetail.looseqty*(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc))*
		(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1 - (.01 * saleledger.discperc)),
	GrossAmt=
		(SELECT SUM((sd.looseqty*(sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * sd.discperc)) * (1- (.01 * sl.discperc)))
		FROM	saledetail sd, saleledger sl
		WHERE sl.saleinvcode=saleledger.saleinvcode and sl.saleinvcode=sd.saleinvcode
		GROUP BY sl.saleinvcode),
	saleledger.flatdisc,
	catcode=saleledger.salecatcode,
	type='S',
	GSTValue = SUM((saledetail.looseqty + saledetail.bonusqty) * saledetail.unitsalestax) + 
		SUM(saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc)) * saledetail.gstperc * 0.01),
	usercode=saleledger.salesmancode

FROM
	saleledger,	 
	saledetail

WHERE
	saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode AND 
	saleledger.date >= :ar_startdate AND saleledger.date <= :ar_enddate AND 
	saleledger.salecatcode IN (:ar_saletype) 

GROUP BY 
	 saleledger.saleinvcode,
	 saleledger.salesmancode,
	 saledetail.icode,
	 saleledger.salecatcode,
	 saleledger.discperc,
	 saleledger.flatdisc,
	 saleledger.invgstperc1,
	 saleledger.salecatcode
UNION ALL
SELECT
	saleledger.saleinvcode,
	saledetail.icode,
	GrossValue = SUM(saledetail.looseqty * saledetail.saleprice ) ,
	ItemDiscValue = SUM((saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc))*
						 (.01 * saledetail.discperc) + saledetail.itemflatdisc ),
	InvItemDiscValue = SUM((saledetail.looseqty*(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc))*
							(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc) ) *  (.01 * saleledger.discperc) ),
	ItemValue=SUM((saledetail.looseqty*(saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc))*
		(1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc))) * (1 - (.01 * saleledger.discperc)),
	GrossAmt=
		(SELECT SUM((sd.looseqty*(sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc)) *
			(1 - (.01 * sd.discperc)) * (1- (.01 * sl.discperc)))
		FROM	saledetail sd, saleledger sl
		WHERE sl.saleinvcode=saleledger.saleinvcode and sl.saleinvcode=sd.saleinvcode
		GROUP BY sl.saleinvcode),
	saleledger.flatdisc,
	catcode=saleledger.salecatcode,
	type='S',
	GSTValue = SUM((saledetail.looseqty + saledetail.bonusqty) * saledetail.unitsalestax) + 
		SUM(saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc)) * saledetail.gstperc * 0.01),
	usercode=saleledger.salesmancode

FROM
	saleledger,	 
	saleinvdetail saledetail

WHERE
	saleledger.impactinventory = 'N' AND
	saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode AND 
	saleledger.date >= :ar_startdate AND saleledger.date <= :ar_enddate AND 
	saleledger.salecatcode IN (:ar_saletype) 
GROUP BY 
	 saleledger.saleinvcode,
	 saleledger.salesmancode,
	 saledetail.icode,
	 saleledger.salecatcode,
	 saleledger.discperc,
	 saleledger.flatdisc,
	 saleledger.invgstperc1,
	 saleledger.salecatcode
UNION ALL
SELECT
	srledger.srinvcode,
	srdetail.icode,
	GrossValue = SUM( srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice ) ,
	ItemDiscValue = SUM((srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice ) * (.01 * srdetail.discperc) ),
	InvItemDiscValue = SUM( ( (srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) *
								(1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc) ) ) * (.01 * srledger.discperc) ),
	ItemValue=SUM((srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice *
		(1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc))) * (1 - (.01 * srledger.discperc))),
	GrossAmt=(SELECT SUM((sd.looseqty * sd.srprice *
			(1 - (.01 * sd.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * sl.discperc)))
		FROM	srdetail sd, srledger sl
		WHERE sl.srinvcode=srledger.srinvcode and sl.srinvcode=sd.srinvcode
		GROUP BY sl.srinvcode),
	srledger.flatdisc,
	catcode=srledger.srcatcode,
	type='R',
	GSTValue = - (SUM((srdetail.looseqty + srdetail.bonusqty) * srdetail.unitsalestax) + 
		SUM(srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice * (1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc)) * srdetail.gstperc * 0.01)),
	usercode=srledger.salesmancode

FROM
	srledger,	 
	srdetail

WHERE
   srledger.srinvcode = srdetail.srinvcode  AND 
	srledger.date >= :ar_startdate AND srledger.date <= :ar_enddate AND 
	srledger.srcatcode IN (:ar_saletype) 
	

GROUP BY
	 srledger.srinvcode,
	 srledger.salesmancode,
	 srdetail.icode,
	 srledger.srcatcode,
	 srledger.discperc,
	 srledger.flatdisc,
	 srledger.invgstperc1,
	 srledger.srcatcode) P, ItemCategory IC, Item I

WHERE
	P.Icode = I.Icode AND 
	I.icatcode IN (:aa_catcode)AND
	I.ICatCode = IC.ICatCode

GROUP BY 
	IC.Icatcode, 
	Ic.Name

ORDER BY 
	Ic.Name, 
	IC.Icatcode
